title: Cobblemon - Poke Legends
description: Pokemon Cobblemon Pack - QoL and Performance mods! The server included in the pack has Raids, Gyms, Mega Evolution, Tera, Alpha Bosses, Paradox, Legendary Pokemon, GTS and more!
body:
## 🚀 Join the #1 Cobblemon Community Today If you love **Minecraft** + **Pokémon**, this is where you belong. **Poke Legends** is a fully developed multiplayer Cobblemon world with real competition, real progression, and a thriving community. --- ## 🌎 What Makes Poke Legends Different? This isn’t a single player modpack you quit after two weeks. This is a **live multiplayer ecosystem:** - Real player gym leaders - Weekly tournaments - A global economy - Constant updates - Hundreds of players online daily You’re stepping into a world that’s already alive. --- ## 💬 Real Players. Real Stories. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ “My favorite part of the server is the community. Since I arrived here on poke legends. I have not only made friends. But I have become part of a great big family.” — ItsZer0 ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ “A lot of features on this server are very cohesive between minecraft, cobblemon, and multiplayer. The whole concept of player gyms is such a neat idea, and it's well executed. Admittedly my favorite part of the server is the economy, I love making shops 🤠” — adamitude ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐| “I started with no knowledge of competitive play, I began my journey to learn it in this server. I challenged myself to use only Bug-type Pokémon and eventually became good at it. This wouldn’t have happened if not for the server. o/” — Tadashji ## 🔥 Core Features ### 🧬 Complete Pokémon Experience - ✅ ALL 1025 Pokémon (no fakemons, no missing mons) - 🐉 Legendaries, Mythicals & Ultra Beasts spawn - 💥 All Mega Evolutions (including Mega ZA) - ⚡ Mega, Dynamax, Gigantamax, Terastallization, Z-Moves - 🐲 Hundreds of rideable Pokémon - 💿 All TMs, TRs & Move Tutors accessible ### 🏆 Competitive & Progression - 🗼 Weekly tournaments with massive prizes - 🛡️ Level 1–100 Battle Pass - 🎯 Global bounty system (become the #1 Poke Hunter) - 💪 Custom EV/IV training systems - 🔎 PokeNav to track spawns - 📘 Research tasks - 🏛️ 8 NPC Gym Leaders + Elite Four - 🏛️ 18+ Real Player Gyms (yes, you can become one) ### 🌍 Three Unique Regions - 🗺️ Oasis – Full survival experience (mobs enabled) - 🌿 Serenity – Peaceful mode (no mobs, no hunger) - 🌈 Utopia – Peaceful mode (no mobs, no hunger) ### 💰 Economy & Community - 💵 Player-run shops & massive economy - 🧢 100+ cosmetics (Shiny Sylveon Hat, Kyogre Sword & more) - 🧸 2,000+ collectible Pokémon plushies - 🐣 Advanced daycare breeding - 💎 Weekly Shiny Saturday boost ### ⚔️ World Events & Bosses - 💥 Alpha bosses with rare loot - 🌑 50+ custom Shadow Pokémon - ✨ Daily / Weekly / Monthly quests - 🍛 Pokésnacks to boost shiny odds, catch rate & friendship ### 🛠 Performance & Quality of Life - 📸 Built-in minimap to see Pokemon round you - 🪧 JEI recipe support - ⛏️ Land protection claim + keep inventory - 🔧 Performance optimizations for better FPS - 🌟 Regular updates & new content --- ## 📥 How To Join 1. Download this modpack. 2. Open Minecraft. 3. Click Play Now. 4. Then join our **[Discord](https://discord.com/invite/F729hzHr4W)** to become part of the community! --- ## About This Modpack This modpack was curated to deliver what we feel is an optimal Cobblemon multiplayer experience for Poke Legends. While not required, this modpack provides enhancements via mods that optimize performance, fix lingering bugs in Vanilla minecraft, refine visuals and audio, and improve gameplay. **WARNING: This modpack is intended for use on the Poke Legends server only.** There is no support for usage in other servers or Single Player worlds. ### Technical Notes * This modpack can run with the standard allocation of 2 GB of RAM **without shaders**. For best performance, or if shaders will be used, please allocate at least 4 GB of RAM.
How do I do this? RAM can be allocated per instance, or globally. Follow the instructions below according to your preference. **Per Instance:** 1. Click on the instance in the Modrinth app. 2. Click on the **cog wheel** button next to the Play button. 3. Select **[Sync overrides]**. 4. Scroll down until you see **Custom memory allocation**, then toggle this setting **ON**. 5. Adjust the slider until the memory allocated is set to 4096 MB. **Global:** 1. Click on the **cog wheel** button in the bottom-left corner of the Modrinth app. 2. Select **[Synced settings]**. 3. Scroll down until you see **memory allocation**. 4. Adjust the slider until the memory allocated is set to 4096 MB. **NOTE:** Per instance settings override global settings.
* Poke Legends only supports **Fabric**. NeoForge and other mod loaders are not and will not be supported. * ⚠️ **MacOS USERS ONLY*: Shaders are not supported due to Apple's deprecation of OpenGL, which Iris heavily relies on. Enabling shaders on your device may cause issues. ### Modpack Contents If you wish to obtain any of the mods below for use outside of Poke Legends, you can download them directly from the pages below to support the respective authors. **Mods:** * [AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin): Food-related HUD improvements. * [Async Logger](https://modrinth.com/mod/asynclogger): Asynchronous logging and efficient filtering. * [Async Pack Scan](https://modrinth.com/mod/async-pack-scan): Speeds up the resource pack organizer screen. * [Auth Me](https://modrinth.com/mod/auth-me): Overcome infamous session validation errors without restarting Minecraft. * [Bad Wither No Cookie Reloaded](https://modrinth.com/mod/bad-wither-no-cookie): Silence sounds that are broadcasted world wide. * [BadOptimizations](https://modrinth.com/mod/badoptimizations): A collection of small performance tweaks. * [Better Advancements](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-advancements): Improvements to the advancements screen. * [Better Third Person](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-third-person): Adds independent camera rotation for third-person view. * [BetterF3](https://modrinth.com/mod/betterf3): Highly customizable, more human-readable HUD. * [Capes](https://modrinth.com/mod/capes): Use capes from Optifine, LabyMod, and the MinecraftCapes Mod. * [CIT Resewn](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn): Enables Custom Item Textures (CIT) for resource packs. * [Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon): The heart and soul of the modpack that brings Pokémon to Minecraft. * [Cobblemon Catch Rate Display](https://modrinth.com/mod/catch-rate-display): See real-time catch rate percentages during battles. * [Cobblemon Extended Battle UI](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon-extended-battle-ui): Expansion for Cobblemon's battle UI. * [Cobblemon Integrations](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon-integrations): Popular mod integrations for Cobblemon. * [Cobblemon Party Extras](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon-party-extras): Cobblemon party/summary screen enhancements. * [Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity): Allow resource packs to use the OptiFine connected textures format. * [Crafting Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/crafting-tweaks): Rotate, balance, or clear the crafting matrix with the press of a button. * [CraftPresnce](https://modrinth.com/mod/craftpresence): Enable Rich Presence for Minecraft in Discord. * [Cubes Without Borders](https://modrinth.com/mod/cubes-without-borders): Play Minecraft in a borderless fullscreen window. * [Debugify](https://modrinth.com/mod/debugify): Fixes bugs on Mojang's official issue tracker. * [Drippy Loading Screen](https://modrinth.com/mod/drippy-loading-screen): Loading screen customization for FancyMenu. * [Dynamic Crosshair](https://modrinth.com/mod/dynamiccrosshair): Crosshair changes shape according to what's targeted. * [Easy Item List](https://modrinth.com/mod/easy-item-list): Automatically add server side custom items to JEI, REI, and EMI. * [EMI](https://modrinth.com/mod/emi): Powerful recipe viewer. * [EMI Enchanting](https://modrinth.com/mod/emi-enchanting): A plugin for EMI that displays information about enhancements. * [EMI Ores](https://modrinth.com/mod/emi-ores): Easily view ore generation info from inside EMI. * [EMI Professions](https://modrinth.com/mod/emi-professions-(emip)): Profession workstations in EMI. * [Enchantment Descriptions](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchantment-descriptions): Adds descriptions of enchantment effects. * [Enhanced Attack Indicator](https://modrinth.com/mod/enhanced-attack-indicator): Show attack indicator progress on additional actions. * [Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling): Improves performance by culling entities not visible to the player. * [Entity Model Features [EMF]](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features): Adds support for OptiFine's Custom Entity Models (CEM). * [Entity Texture Features [ETF]](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures): Adds support for OptiFine's Entity Texture Features (ETF). * [Exordium](https://modrinth.com/mod/exordium): Renders the in-game GUI on its own FPS limiter. * [Falling Leaves](https://modrinth.com/mod/fallingleaves): Adds a particle effect to leaf blocks. * [FancyMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/fancymenu): Customizable Minecraft menus. * [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core): Reduces RAM usage. * [GUI Scale Splitter](https://modrinth.com/mod/gui-scale-splitter): Scale the scoreboard, tab list, and title separately. * [ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast): Speeds up and optimizes immediate mode rendering. * [Inventory Profiles Next](https://modrinth.com/mod/inventory-profiles-next): Powerful inventory sorting features. * [InvMove](https://modrinth.com/mod/invmove): Allows you to move while viewing your inventory. * [InvMoveCompats](https://modrinth.com/mod/invmovecompats): Enhances InvMove's compatibility with REI/JEI/EMI/Ponder. * [Jade](https://modrinth.com/mod/jade): Shows information about the block you're looking at. * [Just Enough Effects Descriptions](https://modrinth.com/mod/just-enough-effect-descriptions-jeed): Addon for REI/JEI/EMI that shows effects and their descriptions. * [Just Enough Items](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei): Item and recipe viewing mod. * [Krypton](https://modrinth.com/mod/krypton): Optimizes the Minecraft networking stack and entity tracker. * [LambDynamicLights](https://modrinth.com/mod/lambdynamiclights): Adds dynamic lights to Minecraft. * [Language Reload](https://modrinth.com/mod/language-reload): Reduces load times and adds fallbacks for languages. * [Make Bubbles Pop](https://modrinth.com/mod/make_bubbles_pop): Bubble particles pop and realistically rise to the water surface. * [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu): Adds a mod menu to view the list of installed mods. * [More Chat History](https://modrinth.com/mod/morechathistory): Increases the length of the chat history from 100 messages to 16,384. * [More Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/moreculling): Changes how multiple types of culling are handled in order to improve performance. * [MoreCobblemonTweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/more-cobblemon-tweaks): A QoL Cobblemon mod with various improvements. * [Not Enough Animations](https://modrinth.com/mod/not-enough-animations): Adds and improves animations in third-person. * [Particle Core](https://modrinth.com/mod/particle-core): Particle optimizations. * [Particle Rain](https://modrinth.com/mod/particle-rain): Replaces weather with prettier particle effects. * [Particular Reforged](https://modrinth.com/mod/particular-reforged): Enhances Minecraft's ambience with added visual effects. * [Presence Footsteps](https://modrinth.com/mod/presence-footsteps): Improved footstep sounds. * [Raised](https://modrinth.com/mod/raised): Fixes broken hotbar selection texture and allows repositioning vanilla and modded GUI layers. * [Reese's Sodium Options](https://modrinth.com/mod/reeses-sodium-options): Improved layout for Sodium's options screen. * [Respackopts](https://modrinth.com/mod/respackopts): Config menus for supported resource packs. * [Shulker Box Tooltip](https://modrinth.com/mod/shulkerboxtooltip): See what's inside your shulker boxes on the Inventory screen. * [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium): Powerful rendering engine for Minecraft that greatly enhances performance and fixes graphical issues. * [Sodium Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra): Additional features for Sodium. * [Sodium Shadowy Path Blocks](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-shadowy-path-blocks): Restores vanilla-like smooth lighting to non-full blocks. * [StackDeobfuscator](https://modrinth.com/mod/stackdeobf): Deobfuscates stacktraces for easier debugging of issues recorded in logs. * [Stendhal](https://modrinth.com/mod/stendhal): Enhances the book writing interface. * [SwingThrough](https://modrinth.com/mod/swingthrough): Allows targeting living entities through transparent blocks. * [Tooltip overhaul](https://modrinth.com/mod/tooltip-overhaul): Modernizes display of tooltips for a sharper and clearer presentation. * [Visuality](https://modrinth.com/mod/visuality): Adds new particle effects for visual improvements. * [Wakes](https://modrinth.com/mod/wakes): Adds splashes and wakes while traveling on water. * [Xaero's Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap): Adds a minimap to the HUD. * [Xaero's World Map](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map): A self-writing fullscreen map and add-on to Xaero's Minimap. * [Your Options Shall be Respected (YOSBR)](https://modrinth.com/mod/yosbr): Provide custom default options if the corresponding configuration files do not exist. * [Zoomify](https://modrinth.com/mod/zoomify): A highly customizable zoom mod. **Dependencies:** * [Architectury API](https://modrinth.com/mod/architectury-api): Required by EasyItemList and MoreCobblemonTweaks. * [Balm](https://modrinth.com/mod/balm): Required by Crafting Tweaks. * [Bookshelf](https://modrinth.com/mod/bookshelf-lib): Required by Enchantment Description. * [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config): Required by several mods to support their in-game configuration menus. * [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api): Required by all fabric mods. * [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin): Required by several mods that use the Kotlin programming language. * [Forge Config API Port](https://modrinth.com/mod/forge-config-api-port): Required by Particular Reforged. * [Fzzy Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/fzzy-config): Required by Particle Core. * [Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris): Required by shader packs. * [Konkrete](https://modrinth.com/mod/konkrete): Required by Drippy Loading Screen and FancyMenu. * [libIPN](https://modrinth.com/mod/libipn): Required by Inventory Profiles Next. * [LibJF](https://modrinth.com/mod/libjf): Required by Async Pack Scan and Respackopts. * [Melody](https://modrinth.com/mod/melody): Required by Drippy Loading Screen and FancyMenu. * Modded](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cobblemon-interface-modded): Mod support for the Cobblemon Interface resource pack. * [E19 - Cobblemon Minimap 📜 Full Text Description (Accessibility) Welcome to **Poke Legends**! This modpack is built for the Poke Legends Cobblemon server, giving you the ultimate Pokémon-in-Minecraft experience. ### Key Features: - **Rideable Cobblemon** – Fly, swim, and run across the world on your favorite Pokémon. - **Mega Evolutions & Dynamax** – Take battles to the next level with powerful transformations. - **Gym Battles** – Challenge leaders and prove your strength. - **Legendary Hunts & Shiny Boosts** – Rare encounters and improved shiny odds. - **Player Shops & Pokémon Cosmetics** – Trade, customize, and show off your style. - **EV Training & Move Tutors** – Build the perfect competitive team. - **Advanced Combat & Bounty Hunts** – Sharpen your skills with unique challenges. - **Research Tasks, Alpha Bosses, and Gyms** – Earn rewards and face epic bosses. - **Daycare System & Plushies** – Breed Pokémon and collect adorable decorations. - **Optimizations** – Mods included to keep the game running smooth. ### How to Join: - Download this modpack. - Open Minecraft. - Click Play Now to instantly connect to the server. - Join our **[Discord](https://discord.com/invite/F729hzHr4W)** for guides, events, and community help!
